# Add Gallery Translations

Read and follow [i18n](../../.agents/skills/i18n/SKILL.md) for the requested messages.
Resolve gallery identifiers using its [artwork naming map](../../.agents/skills/i18n/references/artwork-naming.md).
Use supplied artwork names, subtitle and confirmed measurements; adapt optional artist prose into page metadata with [seo](../../.agents/skills/seo/SKILL.md) when needed.

Keep this task limited to the two locale files unless the user requests changes to consumers.
Verify affected key parity, interpolation and JSON validity, and report any missing source facts.
